human_observations.observation: Mike intentionally photographed the LED wall from approximately the same position on the left side throughout the project.
human_observations.editorial_opportunity: Potential matched-viewpoint progress visualization from installation through completion.
human_observations.viewpoint_notes: Two closely related sub-positions within the left-of-wall area, both consistent with Jane's observation. (A) Orange 'KessmanGroup' tool chest foreground — appears across 5 shoot dates (2026-05-19, 05-28, 06-09, 07-15), strong evidence Mike returned to the same spot. (B) Elevated far-left with dark door frame on the left edge — appears on 2026-04-26 (before/early) and 2026-08-21 (completed), framing the full progression. Near-completion and completed shots from the far-left looking down the wall's length (I0015, I0043, I0040, I0030, I0033) align with the same general viewpoint.
gaps: No matched-viewpoint capture between 2026-06-09 and 2026-07-15 (5-week gap during black-backing to frame-structure transition).
No matched-viewpoint capture between 2026-07-15 and 2026-07-17 (I0008/I0010 are nearby but from a more frontal/centered angle, not the same left-of-wall position).
No matched-viewpoint capture between 2026-07-31 and 2026-08-21 (3-week gap between near-completion testing and the completed hero shots).

human_curated_sequences.description: Human-curated photo progression showing the Aliante LED wall evolving from early structure/scaffolding through LED installation to completed state. Photos taken from roughly the same viewpoint, quite close in framing.
human_curated_sequences.scope_clarification: This photo progression is not the full Aliante case study video. It is one potentially useful supporting editorial device within the larger case study project. Generating this sequence does not complete the case study video project.
human_curated_sequences.before_clarification: These are NOT true 'before' photos of Aliante's old projector/screen setup. They are 'before' only in the sense that they show the wall before LUCI began installing LED panels. This sequence must not be used to support messaging about Aliante's previous AV system or prior sportsbook technology. It should be treated as a construction/build progression sequence.
human_curated_sequences.framing_notes: These photos were taken from roughly the same viewpoint and are quite close in framing. Jane has already determined that most can be cropped/reframed to align reasonably well. One image is notably less aligned than the others, but the overall set is still strong enough to test as a continuous visual progression.

human_curated_sequences.creative_opportunity: The viewer may be able to watch the wall effectively build itself in place from early structure to final LED installation.

editorial_guidance.value: The value of this set is the ordered visual progression, not strict before/during/after labeling.
editorial_guidance.phase_documentation_caveat: There is effectively only one strong 'during' image, so do not treat this as comprehensive phase-by-phase documentation.
editorial_guidance.first_three_images: The first three images are earlier build states, not evidence of Aliante's previous AV system.
editorial_guidance.payoff_image: The completed image (I0027) should function as the visual payoff if this sequence is used.

editorial_constraints.decision: V0024 and V0026 were originally recorded as potential narration or interview-driven A-roll. After review, Jane determined these interviews are not strong enough to serve that purpose in the finished case study.
should_use: May support factual understanding, claim verification, detail identification, and inspiration for later copy
Final copy must be written appropriately, not presented as verbatim customer testimonial
should_not_use: Do not build the case-study video around V0024/V0026 as talking-head A-roll
Do not use original audio as primary narration
Do not use interview sound bites as the main storytelling device
Do not assume one of these speakers should carry the video
editorial_constraints.speaker_context: All identified speakers are LUCI team members, not Aliante customer-side personnel. No usable customer interview available.
editorial_constraints.production_constraint: Absence of usable interview A-roll is a production constraint, not a reason to force these recordings into the video.
editorial_constraints.case_study_structure: Develop primarily from available project footage/photography, verified project story/claims, and whatever narrative treatment is selected during editorial/design stages.
deep_media_review_implication: Do not prioritize V0024 or V0026 as final interview/A-roll candidates
Do not spend additional review effort looking for usable interview quotes unless a specific factual need arises
If either recording contains independently useful non-interview visual material, it may still be evaluated on that basis
